semiconductor_relevance: High — Kingyoup Enterprises specializes in semiconductor inspection equipment and precision tools, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Kingyoup Enterprises Co., Ltd. is a distributor of precision tools and semiconductor inspection equipment, providing a diverse range of products and services to meet customer needs. With a focus on industrial inspection applications, the company has established expertise in metrology and offers solutions across various sectors.
capabilities: Temporary wafer bonding and laser de-bonder equipment

regional_presence.Taiwan: Kingyoup has its headquarters in Taipei and operates service centers in Hsinchu, Taichung, Tainan, and Kaohsiung.
regional_presence.China: The company has service centers in Suzhou, Taicang, and Kunshan.
